_readme: Impact-graph v3 benchmark (spec 2026-08-11 §17): 30 diverse events with
manually drafted INITIAL labels -- important causal paths, key companies,
direction, acceptable ripple depth. Labels are calibration starting
points to be refined against reviewed outputs, not ground truth.

events.title: Strait of Hormuz closed to all shipping after military escalation
events.body: All tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz, which carries about a fifth of global crude and a third of LNG, halted indefinitely.

events.title: RBI cuts repo rate 50bps in surprise move
events.body: The RBI cut the repo rate by 50 basis points citing cooling inflation, and signalled an accommodative stance.

events.title: Unemployment rate rises to 5.6% in April-June quarter
events.body: PLFS data shows rural unemployment at 4.8% vs 4.3% prior quarter; urban 6.7%.
events.notes: No forced winners; Crompton-style 'affordable goods winner' hypotheses must NOT appear as high-confidence beneficiaries.

events.title: IMD: monsoon rainfall 18% below normal through July
events.body: Sowing of kharif crops lags last year by 12%; reservoir levels at 5-year lows across central India.

events.title: India imposes 25% safeguard duty on Chinese steel imports
events.body: The government imposed a safeguard duty on flat steel products from China effective immediately for two years.

events.title: Rupee falls past 90/USD on portfolio outflows
events.body: The rupee weakened 2.1% in a week to a record low; RBI seen intervening.

events.title: Government clears Rs 1.2 lakh crore defence acquisition plan
events.body: DAC cleared indigenous fighter jets, submarines and missile systems purchases with 75% domestic sourcing requirement.

events.title: US proposes 100% tariff on imported generic drugs
events.body: Draft executive order would levy tariffs on generics manufactured outside the US, phased over 18 months.

events.title: Global automotive chip shortage returns as Taiwan fab output halves
events.body: A major Taiwanese foundry cut output after contamination; auto-grade MCU lead times double.

events.title: Mid-size private bank reports Rs 8,000 crore loan fraud
events.body: The bank disclosed a borrower fraud requiring full provisioning over two quarters; CET1 falls near regulatory minimum.
events.notes: Company-specific: contagion to other banks must be low-confidence unless systemic channel argued.

events.title: GST Council cuts small-car tax rate from 28% to 18%
events.body: Effective next quarter, small cars and two-wheelers move to the 18% slab.

events.title: OPEC+ announces surprise 2M bpd output increase
events.body: The group will raise output starting next month, citing market share defence; Brent falls 8%.

events.title: Thermal plant coal stocks fall below 4 days as heatwave lifts demand
events.body: Power demand hit records; several states report load shedding and spot power prices tripled.

events.title: New e-commerce FDI rules bar platform private labels
events.body: Draft policy prohibits marketplaces from selling own-brand goods and mandates equal seller treatment.

events.title: Largest cement maker acquires No.4 player for $6B
events.body: The deal adds 40MTPA capacity, taking the acquirer past 200MTPA; CCI review expected.

events.title: Top IT firm cuts FY guidance on BFSI spending freeze
events.body: The company guided flat revenue citing US banking client budget cuts; peers fall in sympathy.
events.notes: Narrow event: ripple depth should stay shallow; no economy-wide fan-out.

events.title: AAA-rated infrastructure NBFC defaults on commercial paper
events.body: The default freezes the CP market for NBFCs; mutual funds side-pocket exposures.

events.title: GSI confirms 5.9M tonne lithium reserve in J&K commercially viable
events.body: Mining rights auction planned within a year; grade comparable to Chilean brine deposits.
events.notes: Long-horizon: time_horizon should be Long-Term, confidence moderate.

events.title: India bans sugar exports for the season
events.body: Citing low cane output, the government prohibited sugar exports; global prices jump 12%.

events.title: 5G spectrum auction concludes 40% above reserve price
events.body: Two major telcos committed Rs 1.5 lakh crore combined; payment over 20 years.

events.title: Red Sea diversions triple container freight rates
events.body: Container rates Asia-Europe tripled in six weeks as carriers route around the Cape.

events.title: Gold import duty doubled to curb CAD
events.body: Customs duty on gold raised from 7.5% to 15% effective immediately.

events.title: Government announces Rs 50,000 crore PSU bank recapitalisation
events.body: Capital infusion targeted at banks under PCA framework, enabling credit growth.

events.title: EU CBAM carbon border tax enters full effect for steel and aluminium
events.body: Indian exporters face 20-35% effective carbon levies on EU shipments from January.

events.title: Cabinet raises paddy MSP 9%, biggest hike in a decade
events.body: The increase lifts assured farm incomes ahead of kharif procurement season.

events.title: Data protection rules mandate local storage for financial data
events.body: Payment firms and banks get 12 months to localise all customer financial data.

events.title: Second-largest budget carrier files for insolvency
events.body: The airline grounded its fleet of 110 aircraft; slots and routes to be redistributed.

events.title: China restricts rare-earth magnet exports
events.body: Export licences now required for NdFeB magnets, hitting EV motor and wind turbine supply chains.

events.title: CPI inflation jumps to 7.4% on food prices
events.body: Vegetable and cereal inflation pushed CPI far above the RBI's tolerance band; core steady at 4.9%.

events.title: National green hydrogen mission allocates Rs 80,000 crore in incentives
events.body: Production-linked incentives for electrolysers and green H2 hubs at ports announced.

events.title: US GDP contracts second straight quarter; recession declared
events.body: US demand contraction confirmed; Fed signals easing cycle.
